text:
janet: noticed kv-cache leak spike in EU causing embed failures. preparing hotfix v2.3.14, target window 01:00-01:30 UTC. requesting expedited approvals to skip canary due to active incidents. details: https://confluence/release/v2.3.14 (root)
deploybot: Deploybot: preflight checks passed. Canary-skip requires 2 release:approve approvers (one oncall).
mike: +1 from me if ops confirms capacity and oncall will watch.
ops-oncall: eu-west1 has spare capacity. i'll stay on thread and monitor. +1.
janet: rollback plan: pin to last-good sha qwe987, traffic cut, no DB changes. auto-rollback if 3m error rate > 2%. Commands: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=image:qwe987 -n prod-eu && deploybot rollback --thread 7987654321 --reason "auto-rollback"`
mike: please add one-line release note for support.
janet: release note: "v2.3.14 1 emergency kv-cache fix to reduce embed misses; rolling EU 01:00-01:30 UTC; no schema changes." link: https://docs/releases/v2.3.14-notes
deploybot: Approval count: 3 (janet, mike, ops-oncall). Initiating rollout. logs: https://deploylogs/7987654321
deploybot: Phase 1 (20%) -> OK. Phase 2 (60%) -> OK. Phase 3 (100%) -> Completed. No sustained error uplift.
ops-oncall: ran sanity probe, got 200. kv-hit-rate improved ~87% vs baseline.
janet: closing rollout, tagging support/product to publish release note. :tada:
thread_summary: Hotfix v2.3.14 for kv-cache leak in EU: expedited approvals (janet, mike, ops-oncall). Canary skipped with approvers watching; phased rollout succeeded; rollback pin qwe987 ready; support notified.
